R1.description: usage --refresh re-reads both the Codex and the Claude limit by one cheap probe each and records the readings

R2.description: A failing probe changes nothing, is named with its cause, and does not skip the other provider

R3.description: The output shows what was read and when, including a stored reading whose window has reset

R4.description: The option is documented where operators look, with the call a watchdog makes before it acts on a hold
